title: Negotiating a Deadline
summaryZh: 工程師向主管說明時程不可行，兩人協商把交付拆成兩次發布。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I've been going over the schedule all morning, and I don't think we can ship by Friday.
sentences.zh: 我整個早上都在看時程，我不覺得我們星期五前交得出來。
sentences.note: going over 的 /ŋ/ 直接連到 over 的母音，聽起來像 /ˈɡoʊɪ.ŋoʊ.vɚ/；don't think 的 t 幾乎消失。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That's not really what I wanted to hear, but go ahead and walk me through it.
sentences.zh: 這不是我想聽到的話，不過你還是說說看吧。
sentences.note: wanted 的 nt 只發 /n/，再加上 to 弱讀，整串聽起來像 /ˈwɑnɪ.tə/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: The testing team only got the build on Tuesday, so they're already three days behind.
sentences.zh: 測試團隊星期二才拿到版本，所以他們已經落後三天了。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: If we push it out now, they can actually catch the bugs before customers do.
sentences.zh: 如果我們現在硬推出去，他們就沒辦法在客戶之前把問題抓出來。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I hear you, but I already told the client we'd have something in their hands Friday.
sentences.zh: 我懂你的意思，可是我已經跟客戶說星期五會給他們東西了。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: What if we hand over the core features on Friday and hold back the reporting tools?
sentences.zh: 如果我們星期五先交核心功能，報表工具晚點再給呢？
sentences.note: What if 連音成 /wʌ.ɾɪf/，t 夾在兩個母音中間變閃音。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: So you're saying we'd split it into two releases instead of one big one?
sentences.zh: 所以你是說要拆成兩次發布，而不是一次大改版？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Exactly, so they get to start using it and we buy ourselves another week for testing.
sentences.zh: 沒錯，他們可以先開始用，我們也替自己多爭取一週測試時間。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That could work, so how much time would you need to finish off the second half?
sentences.zh: 這或許行得通，那你需要多久才能把後半段做完？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Give me until Wednesday, because I'd rather promise that and deliver than promise Friday and slip.
sentences.zh: 給我到星期三，我寧願答應星期三然後做到，也不要答應星期五卻跳票。
sentences.note: Give me 的 v 常被吃掉，聽起來像 /ˈɡɪmi/；I'd rather 的 d 很輕。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Okay, I'll get on a call with them this afternoon and set up the new plan.
sentences.zh: 好，我下午跟他們通個電話，把新的計畫敲定。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll write up a short summary so you've got all the details in front of you.
sentences.zh: 謝了，我會寫個簡短的說明，讓你手邊有完整的細節。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Send it over by two, and next time please flag this kind of thing a week earlier.
sentences.zh: 兩點前寄給我，還有下次這種事請提早一週提出來。
sentences.note: Send it over 三字連成一串，it 的 t 變閃音，聽起來像 /sɛn.dɪ.ˈɾoʊ.vɚ/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Fair enough, I should have brought it up the moment the build slipped last week.
sentences.zh: 說得也對，上週版本一延我就該講的。
sentences.note: should have 口語縮成 /ˈʃʊɾəv/，d 變閃音；brought it up 三字連讀。

questions.q: Why does the speaker think the deadline should move?
What compromise do they agree on?
options: Ship the core features Friday and the rest by Wednesday
Delay the whole release until Wednesday
Ship everything Friday and fix the bugs later

questions.q: What does the manager ask for at the end?
options: A meeting with the testing team
A written apology to the client
